prompt: Players die to the same boss forty times, laugh, and scream with joy when they finally beat it.
tells: die to the same boss forty times
why: Overcoming something hard after many failures is the fun of challenge.
trap: The screaming feels like sensation, but the joy comes from finally winning.

prompt: Reviewers praise a platformer as 'brutal but fair': every death feels like your own fault.
tells: every death feels like your own fault
why: Fair difficulty that rewards improvement is challenge.
trap: Smooth movement helps, but fairness under difficulty is the point.

prompt: A community spends years shaving tenths of a second off their best times.
why: Pushing mastery to its limit is challenge.
trap: They do find tricks, but the goal is beating the clock.

prompt: Asked to describe a run-and-gun game with relentless bosses in one word, most players say 'hard'.
why: When 'hard' is the word players use, the fun is challenge.
trap: Style and music matter, but the defining feeling is beating hard bosses.

prompt: Players grind ranked matches for weeks to climb from Silver to Gold, even though the rewards are cosmetic.
why: Proving skill against a measurable bar is challenge.
trap: The cosmetics aren't the draw; the climb is.

prompt: A studio refuses to add an easy mode because overcoming the difficulty is the whole point of the game.
tells: overcoming the difficulty is the whole point
why: The design is built around challenge as the core fun.
trap: Difficulty tuning is the lever; the question is what fun they're protecting.
